# HTTPRetry 0.9

HTTPRetry is a small Python library that retries failed HTTP calls, so network hiccups, rate limits, and flaky APIs are less likely to crash your app.

Version 0.9 includes:

- Exponential backoff, which spaces out each retry so you stop hammering servers that are already struggling.
- Jitter, which randomizes retry delays so many clients don't all retry at the same moment (the "thundering herd" problem).
- No dependencies, so there is nothing extra to install and nothing to conflict with.
- 94% test coverage.

It suits microservices, scrapers, and integrations with third-party APIs. Install it, wrap your requests, and you should see fewer errors and fewer middle-of-the-night pager alerts.
